summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K announcing publication of a Fourth Supplementary Prospectus dated 3 August 2026 relating to its €40 billion Euro Medium Term Note Programme of 5 December 2025. The supplementary prospectus was approved by the UK Financial Conduct Authority and made available via RNS and the National Storage Mechanism. This is a routine disclosure for a debt issuance programme, not a special-situation event such as an acquisition, restructuring, or similar. The filing contains no deal terms, premiums, or corporate actions beyond updating the programme documentation. The registrant is the issuer of the notes, but the disclosure is ordinary regulatory maintenance.
